subject: Flexible payment buffer + rolling credit limit for upcoming renewal
messages:
From: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@aureliahealth.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Singh <maya.singh@aureliahealth.com>
Date: 2026-09-01T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: renewal / terms discussion

Diego — thanks for the heads up on renewal cadence. We’re generally good with renewing, but our finance team is pushing for Net60 for all SaaS vendors this year. Two follow-ups: (1) can Redwood hold the current committed capacity for an extra 30 days between invoice and payment (some of our customers are on slower PO cycles); and (2) we need to confirm whether Redwood can issue invoices from an EU-registered entity (we have VAT recovery requirements) — our AP needs the VAT number on the invoice.

We’re also asking about whether you can provide a short-term credit buffer (rolling credit limit) for Aug–Sep usage while our procurement closes the PO. If you have a simple amendment or PO-attachment workflow, please send it over.

—Jordan
CFO, Aurelia Health

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@aureliahealth.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-01T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: renewal / terms discussion

Jordan — appreciate the clarity. Quick answers up front: we can support Net60 and we can invoice from our EU entity (we’ll include VAT reg. and local tax fields). For the short-term buffer, we typically offer either (A) a 30-day rolling credit line (pre-agreed cap, invoiced monthly) or (B) milestone-tied invoicing where we hold capacity until PO arrives and invoice only for consumed commitment.

Proposal (recommended to keep things simple):
- Start with Net60 for standard invoices.
- Provide a 60k EUR rolling credit buffer for 45 days to bridge the PO gap (this is a temporary one-off buffer tied to this renewal).
- Invoice schedule: monthly usage invoice + quarterly committed-seat invoice. If PO arrives, we apply payment to outstanding balance and remove buffer.

I’ve attached a short amendment draft that outlines the buffer and Net60 terms (see "Redwood_Amendment_v2.pdf"). Rafael (cc) will confirm the accounting treatment and any constraints. If that works, we can circulate a DocuSign link for signature and you can push your PO.

Thanks — I’ll stand by for the VAT details.

—Diego
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@aureliahealth.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-01T12:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: renewal / terms discussion

Jordan — quick finance note from our side: the 60k EUR rolling buffer is within our standard credit extension threshold for established customers. Two clarifications: (1) interest/late fees — for this one-off buffer we’ll waive interest as long as the PO is received within 45 days; (2) VAT invoicing — we can issue invoices from our EU subsidiary (Redwood Inference Ltd., UK VAT GB999888777). Please confirm whether Aurelia will receive the invoice net of VAT or with VAT applied (we can do both depending on your registration status).

Action items for Aurelia to unblock:
- Send VAT registration number for the invoicing entity (if you want net VAT treatment).
- Confirm PO timeline and whether accounting will accept the amendment as a short-term contract addendum.

I’ve uploaded an editable schedule (SOW_payment_schedule.xlsx) that maps committed seats to invoice triggers — Rafael

From: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@aureliahealth.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Singh <maya.singh@aureliahealth.com>
Date: 2026-09-02T09:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: renewal / terms discussion

Thanks, Rafael and Diego. We’ll accept Net60 and the 60k EUR buffer looks fine as long as the waiver language is explicit. Regarding VAT: Aurelia will be invoiced to our UK entity (Aurelia Health Ltd.), VAT reg: GB123456789. Please issue invoices net of VAT (reverse-charge) and include our VAT number on every invoice.

Next steps from our side: I’ve routed this to procurement and they’ll upload the PO once we have the DocuSign amendment. I’m attaching the PO as a placeholder (Aurelia_PO_4578.pdf) — it won’t be fully approved until Tuesday but it’s the right reference. Can you send the DocuSign for the amendment and confirm expected settlement behavior once PO lands?

—Jordan

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@aureliahealth.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-03T16:44:00-07:00
Subject: Re: renewal / terms discussion

Jordan — great, thanks for the VAT number and the placeholder PO. We’ve: 
- Updated the amendment to call out the 60k EUR rolling buffer, 45-day waiver, and Net60 payment window (attached: Redwood_Amendment_v2.pdf).
- Configured invoices from Redwood Inference Ltd. with VAT reg GB999888777 and will include Aurelia Health Ltd. VAT GB123456789 for reverse-charge netting.
- Generated a DocuSign envelope (https://www.docusign.com/signed/7a2b9efc) for the amendment; once signed we’ll mark the buffer active and accept the placeholder PO as the intake reference.

Next steps: please sign the DocuSign and confirm when procurement uploads the final PO. Once the PO is in, finance will apply it to the outstanding balance and remove the buffer hold. Rafael — I’ll loop you in internally to pull the buffer into our AR system. Marissa — can you confirm whether we need any additional billing fields for Aurelia’s AP system?

Thanks — looking forward to getting this closed so there’s no disruption to their dedicated capacity.

—Diego
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
